DiagramService
|-- DiagramService: create, getRevision, listRevisions, revise, generate
|-- This public boundary is the sole diagram content writer.
|-- RevisionedDiagramService implements DiagramService
|-- An optional generator is referenced; its lifetime ownership is unspecified.
|-- create(input) -> DiagramRevisionEditor.prepareCreate(input) -> issue(...)
|-- Local revision creation is synchronous.
|-- revise(baseRevisionId, edit) -> getRevision(...) -> prepareEdit(...)
|-- An unchanged edit returns the base; a change preserves diagramId.
|-- issue(...) -> diagramRevisions.register({ id, diagramId, parentId?, diagram, nodeRefs })
|-- Node correspondence preserves prior stable references where available.
|-- getRevision(id) -> diagramRevisions.get(id); listRevisions(id) -> frozen summaries
|-- Registry storage is accessed through an imported internal module.
|-- generate(request, options) -> generator.generate(clonedRequest, options) -> revise | create
`-- Generation checks abort signals and rejects a base belonging to another local diagram.
